property_summary: For any fuzzer-chosen deposit amount, a withdrawAll by an adversarial re-entrant caller completes successfully and leaves the contract's balance drained exactly once (address(c).balance == 0); the buggy reset-after-call version lets the re-entrant caller withdraw a second time, causing a balance underflow/revert that makes the call fail.
change_summary: Move the credit reset to after the external call, enabling reentrancy and changing the state during the call.
